title: Rav Hamnuna son of Rav Yosef
author: Aharon Hyman
attribution: Model-assisted translation, editorially reviewed; publication authorized by Joshua Waxman.
copyright: English translation and editorial notes © 2026 Joshua Waxman. All rights reserved.
paragraphs: He was Rava’s student, as in [Berakhot 24a](https://www.sefaria.org/Berakhot.24a.4), where he said: “Once I was standing before Rava, and he said to me, ‘Go bring me tefillin’ — to teach us a practical halakhah.” Hyman reports that Dikdukei Soferim reads Rabbi Nechemyah son of Rav Yosef.[^1]

notes.text: [The Rif](https://www.sefaria.org/Rif_Berakhot.15a.2) agrees with the linked Gemara in naming Rav Hamnuna son of Rav Yosef. [The Rosh](https://www.sefaria.org/Rosh_on_Berakhot.3.34.1) has Rav Nechemyah son of Rav Yosef. [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=1055&lang=en) records that difference. The exact Dikdukei Soferim reading remains as Hyman reports it.
